revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - See WGC's comments, to be rendered as PN corrections (image checked). || lin10 Ε̣ὐτ[υ]χ̣οὺς => Ε̣ὐτ[υ]χ̣οῦς

Vote - AcceptText - Corrections are good. The ed. pr. is sloppy with dots and brackets (e.g. μετόχοι πράκτορ(ες) is not perfectly clear in l. 2; not all of πράκτορ(σι) l. 12 is on papyrus). A few notes. 1: (ἔ̣τ̣ο̣υ̣ς̣) α̣, like l. 9. Not sure how ed. pr. got idea ἔτους was written out after year sign. 2: there’s a correction of some sort to end of διέγραψαν; in any case, regularize to διέγραψεν Πατῶμι μετόχοις πράκτορσι. 3: end of line has a pretty clear alpha with line over it, which is not compatible with ed. pr.'s reading (not sure what's happening, but perhaps ref. to 1st year here, despite τοῦ αὐτοῦ (ἔτους) in next line. 7: papyrus actually has δραχ\α/μς. 12: I'd print Μοῦ⟨ι⟩ς. Final letter is lunate like sigma of Σεουήρου. 22: φιλ for the first three dotted letters, possibly for Φιλ[ο(πάτορος)] again, although it doesn’t follow the formula from above. Note that ll. 9-21 contain payments for ca. 40 dr., so assuming that was for laographia, it’d make sense that a new receipt starts here.
